'''Kresk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. As head of the [[Imperial Ordnance Acquisition Corps]], he was responsible for collecting all technological advances deemed necessary for the defense of the Empire. One such collection was on the moon, [[CZ-198]] where with information gained from Czerka executive [[Eva Kaayz]], the Moff's organization was able to acquire several technologies before being seized by the Republic's [[Department of Adjudication]].<ref name="Titans" />
